mentions.name: Katipo (new internet with Vulkan-based browser)
mentions.description: A new internet project accessed through a Vulkan-based browser; the network's only public site so far is a playable Breakout clone.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I’m working on a new internet.

There is a Vulkan based browser which you can use to connect to the only public site so far, a playable breakout clone.
